Title: London Museum of Water & Steam, Brentford
ScheduleText: Thursday–Sunday 10:00–16:00 (last entry 15:00); open every day in October half-term (24 Oct – 1 Nov 2026). Steam Up event days cost more
PriceText: Under 5s free; 5–16 £4; adult £12; family (1 adult + 2 children) £13, (2+2) £25
Description: Giant working steam engines and the story of London's water in a Victorian pumping station
NeedsInfo: The Splash Zone (water play) is closed from 26 October 2026 for building works
